simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֵזֶק (H2391) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: חֵזֶק (chêzeq) means help First listed occurrence: Ps 18 2.

definitions.full: H2391. chezeq [ חֵ֫זֶק ] noun [masculine] strength , only ׳י חִזְקִי Psa 18:2 (omitted by error || 2Sam 22:2 where ᵐ5 L ἰσχύς μου ). (De and others derive from חֹזֶק , but [ חֶזְקָה ] favours חֵזֶק ).
